morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接在 malam 前，词根首音 m 保留，不发生鼻音替换；前缀中的 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 在某处过夜、住宿或留宿。
senses.en_definition: To spend the night or stay overnight somewhere.
senses.ms_definition: Tidur atau menginap di sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 是不及物动词，地点通常由 di 引出。强调度过夜晚，不等于 sepanjang malam 不睡觉；表达“熬夜”一般用 berjaga malam。[DBP：bermalam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=bermalam)

collocations.en: stay overnight at a relative's house

senses.zh_definition: 指熟食已放置过夜，常带有不再新鲜、味道变差或已经变质的意味。
senses.en_definition: Of cooked food, to have been kept overnight, often with an implication of staleness or deterioration.
senses.ms_definition: Sudah disimpan semalam, berkenaan masakan, sehingga sudah basi atau tidak sedap lagi dimakan.
senses.nuances: 这里描述食物的状态，常与 sudah 连用。若只是中性说明食物已冷藏一夜，disimpan semalaman 更明确；bermalam 在这一词典义中往往带失鲜意味。

collocations.en: a cooked dish that has been kept overnight

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan penyelidik akan bermalam di pusat latihan sebelum meneruskan kerja lapangan pada keesokan harinya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 研究团队将在培训中心住宿一晚，翌日继续开展实地工作。
dual_scenarios.en: The research team will stay overnight at the training centre before continuing its fieldwork the following day.

dual_scenarios.zh: 这么晚了，要不你就在我家住一晚？
dual_scenarios.en: It's getting late. Do you want to just stay at my place tonight?

etymology.historical_story: Bermalam makes the familiar noun malam, meaning night, into a verb through the prefix ber-. Its two dictionary meanings share the same passage of time: a traveller spends a night somewhere, while a cooked dish remains through the night. This everyday connection links hospitality and household food vocabulary without suggesting that the prefix itself means sleep.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: malam 是“夜晚”；ber- 让它成为经历或活动：bermalam 就是“在那里过一夜”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 邀请客人留宿可说 Jika tidak keberatan, bolehlah bermalam di sini，语气比直接要求对方留下更体贴。对长辈避免随意使用 kau。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在别人家留宿，应先征得主人同意，并确认到达时间及住宿安排。单独说 bermalam 只表示过夜，不应自行推断为亲密关系。
